rationale: C07 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. It contains a highly distinctive cluster of ideas and language repeated in compressed form: the stabilization program as a vital component of defense mobilization and national security, the determination to maintain a strong program, and the goal of turning it over to the new Administration as a functioning and effective operation. C21 and C24 are weaker appointment-letter analogues sharing willingness to serve, relevant mobilization experience, and appreciation of service, but neither matches the child's central stabilization-and-transition formulation as closely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the stabilization program is a vital part of our defense mobilization and our national security
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The stabilization program is a vital part of our defense mobilization. The mobilization program, in turn, is vital to our security.
shared_material.explanation: Near-literal repetition of the same causal relationship among stabilization, defense mobilization, and national security.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the maintenance of a strong stabilization program which can be turned over to the new administration as a functioning and effective operation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is therefore my firm intention to continue a strong stabilization program and turn it over to the new Administration as a functioning, effective entity.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared language and identical administrative objective strongly indicate reuse.

shared_material.child_excerpt: for the remaining days of my administration
shared_material.parent_excerpt: during my remaining tenure in office
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the stabilization task around the short transition period before the successor administration.
